candidate_question_cn: 世界模型能否从输入潜状态分辨现实观测与自身想象，从而在不添加外部观测触发器的情况下只对想象改变行为？
report_note_cn: 冻结 TD-MPC2 原生控制在两个新回合得994.12和974.09分，均通过900分基线门槛。固定来源识别器对匹配动作的一步／两步想象识别率为92.57%–98.19%，但真实状态误报分别为0.80%和1.61%，第二回合超过预设1%，因此整体确认失败。实际规划器抽样中，深度0误报为0，深度1／2被标记比例为70.69%–84.13%；这只是抽样来源信号，未修改世界模型、未运行攻击，也没有任务损害证据。LayerNorm结构必要条件未分离现实与想象。保留观察，不放宽门槛、不继续调此分类器；一般分布外路由与想象偏差已有先行工作，尚无达到新意目标的主张。
next_requirement: Identify a substantive threat operation and causal property beyond ordinary OOD-based routing and latent checkpoint backdoors on a competent native controller. Do not tune this fixed origin classifier using seeds18/19 or interpret classification as task harm. Retain the original novelty and multiple-task goals; no long GPU experiment.

usage.timing_limit: Confirmation elapsed includes CPU probes and file writes; these are not GPU utilization measurements. Export parity verification CPU time was not measured.

closest_priors.title: Fooling LIME and SHAP: Adversarial Attacks on Post hoc Explanation Methods
closest_priors.finding: Primary abstract, paper and official implementation inspected. An OOD detector distinguishes real examples from explainer perturbations and routes behavior. Merely recognizing query origin and conditionally changing outputs is not a new security operation. No reproduction.

closest_priors.title: TRAP: Tail-aware Ranking Attack for World-Model Planning
closest_priors.finding: Primary abstract describes a trigger-conditioned world-model backdoor targeting decision-critical imagined-trajectory ranking, with dual gates and experiments on DreamerV3 and TD-MPC2. Generic corruption of imagined-trajectory ranking already has a security prior. The abstract alone does not establish a parameter-free inference-only attack; no local reproduction.

closest_priors.title: A Control Theory of Predictability in Latent World Models
closest_priors.finding: Primary abstract and section structure inspected; full theorem assumptions not verified. Discusses planner trajectories leaving data support and the distinction between prediction error on observed data and control performance. Ordinary off-manifold rollout error is not itself a novel attack. No reproduction.

closest_priors.title: When the World Lies: Backdoor Attacks on Latent World Models for Downstream Control
closest_priors.finding: Primary abstract inspected. Poisoned checkpoints route externally triggered observations into altered latent dynamics that affect downstream control. Imagination-origin routing would need a substantive mechanistic distinction and native causal task harm, not merely another trigger label.
